propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as a second human approval, when it is actually a single configured release identity (JoeOakhartNava) with self-review permitted
the release approval is executed non-interactively via the pending_deployments REST API, not through an interactive GitHub UI prompt as the runbook currently instructs
the approval mechanism provides identity and ref control over who can release the publish job, not independent content review—the content review guarantee comes from Gerrit review on main branch
the runbook must document the complete, correctly-typed REST invocation with environment_ids as a JSON array of integers, not via string-typed field flags
the workflow release.yml line 294 comment repeats the incorrect second-human-approval framing and must be corrected to match the rewritten documentation
